# SetRack

> Android gym log. Fully offline: no account, no ads, no trackers and no internet
> permission. Data lives only on the phone. Free.
> Last reviewed: 2026-11-26.

## Verifiable facts (checked 2026-11-26)

- Version 1.0.18 on Google Play (versionCode 351).
- How it works: pick a daily proposal (routine or learned split), a free session or a 2-tap Quick Log; log weight & reps (including unilateral L/R), timed sets with stopwatch, or 1-tap care/mobility checks. Android launcher shortcuts open Train or History directly.
- Sections: features, how it works, questions, data with the full policy, support.

- The APK declares no INTERNET permission; its only system permission is VIBRATE (the tick when logging a set).
- Exercises, sets, weights and optional body measurements are stored only in local storage.
- Manual backup file in Downloads, restore from that file, and CSV export (sets and body measurements).
- Optional Body tracking (off by default): body weight with smoothed trend line, optional weight goal with estimated date, waist (and waist-to-height ratio), chest, arms, forearms, thighs and calves (L/R), plus relative strength (× bodyweight) on exercise charts.
- 140 base exercises (gym, home bodyweight, timed holds, rotator cuff/mobility and cardio) with muscle and equipment; users can add their own.
- 8 colour themes, two of them light.
- Three starter programs (Upper/Lower, Push/Pull/Legs, Full body) with planned sets per exercise.
- Estimated 1RM (continuous up to 25 reps); weekly strength view and progress by week, month, quarter or year.
- Adaptive layout for phones, foldables and tablets (side rail and multi-pane views).
- Suggests exercises by the sets each muscle still needs this week.
- The app is in 17 languages (Spanish, English, Portuguese (Brazil), German, French, Italian, Polish, Dutch, Indonesian, Turkish, Swedish, Norwegian, Danish, Czech, Japanese, Korean, Traditional Chinese); this website is in 11 languages. Kilos or pounds.
- Status: available on Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.setrack.app
